initial_scale: RMS of rolling causal forecast residuals at common target times wholly inside the training prefix. All methods receive identical initial scales.
comparison: Path-paired proper interval score against horizon and shortest; same forecasts, threshold controllers, rates and initial scales. Pointwise Monte Carlo intervals; any invalid interval score invalidates the whole score group. The normalized per-issuance convex loss does not imply unweighted interval-score regret or conditional coverage.
scope: Third engineering pilot following two unsuccessful objectives (paired moment transfer and density-surrogate mixing), fixed before fresh pilot seeds. Full profile has further disjoint paths if retained, with no tuning on confirmatory results. Show all six stress regimes and all configured leads.
mixture_rule: Per-lead linear mixture of own-lead EWMA RMS and shortest-lead EWMA RMS times fixed training ratios. Weights begin at one half; mature feedback updates current weights with normalized interval-score subgradient from frozen old issuance context, projected to [0,1]. Update only 0<q_issue<1; q controller still receives every mature label and is never clipped.
half_rule: Same linear mixture fixed at weight one half, with identical q controller and residual scales; it isolates the value of learning weights.
